criteria.name: Clinical correctness and generalization
criteria.question: Does the final system recover the intended clinical result, and what changes outside development?

criteria.name: Clinical selection and unsupported inference
criteria.question: Does the system select a warranted current fact rather than an unsupported, historical, planned, or ambiguous one?

criteria.name: Evidence support and faithfulness
criteria.question: Is cited text present, and does it semantically support the selected conclusion?

criteria.name: Uncertainty and selective action
criteria.question: Do uncertainty signals identify failures, and can they support abstention or review at acceptable burden?

criteria.name: Robustness and stability
criteria.question: Does the decision persist across relevant data, sampling, wording, prompt, parser, or runtime changes?

criteria.name: Component attribution and correction safety
criteria.question: Which component changes the answer, and does deterministic correction help without damaging correct model output?

criteria.name: Coverage and clinical-slice behavior
criteria.question: Which clinical families and hard cases are covered, missing, or materially weaker?

criteria.name: Operational reliability
criteria.question: Does the named runtime complete predictably, with failures, repairs, retries, latency, and usage reported at their measured scope?

task_criteria.summary: Six-model test450 Purist and Pragmatic accuracy plus the retained subject development/test comparison.
Unknown-gold active-rate over-read is retained; selected denominator counts are absent from the compact source.
Textual grounding is measured; independent semantic-support review is not selected.
External-signal calibration and full risk-coverage results are retained for the named subject.
Prompt-version and one-model repeated-temperature results cover named subdimensions only.
The shared normalization ablation is measured; the retained compact package does not reproduce every stage transition count.
Seizure-band variation is measured; demographic fairness is not measured.
Six-model failures and repairs plus a bounded historical cost estimate are measured; efficiency telemetry is unmatched.
Six-model dev140 and aggregate-only test60 clinical-headline F1.
The predeclared unknown-only denominator is zero; empty-gold letters are not substitutes.
Final exact evidence is measured; a stratified semantic-support sample awaits independent review.
Internal scoring-rule calibration and a historical three-model negative routing result are retained.
Six-model development-to-holdout changes are measured; perturbation robustness is not.
Six-model score stages, historical family regressions, and SF correction transitions remain separate.
All four fixed families are reported for six models; demographic fairness is not measured.
Six-model test60 completion and parse/schema behavior are retained with hosted/local routes separate.
